text:
tess (Design): quick design sync — we need clearer copy for the on‑prem connectivity step. customers read "run checks" and ask if were running commands or sending creds. want short, explicit lines.

ben (UX): totally. propose: "Run connectivity checks (recommended)" and one line: "Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health‑checker IPs. No credentials or commands are sent." keeps it explicit.

kai (Eng): accurate. probe order: TCP handshake -> SSH probe when port 22 -> optional HTTP GET. originates from fixed IPs (i'll paste ranges). we do not authenticate. note: probe is IPv4 only today.

marie (Product): policy: default OFF for private/on‑prem, ON for hosted. add a fallback CTA: "Run checks from Redwood (recommended)" and "Run locally (manual)" which downloads a one‑shot probe script.

tess (Design): UI ask: show small status chips for each probe type (TCP · SSH · HTTP) with success/fail. on failure show an inline hint + a "Troubleshoot" link that expands remediation steps.

ben (UX): accessibility: toggle needs aria-describedby text that includes the probe behavior and that no credentials are sent. use a polite live region that announces: "Connectivity checks running" then final status and suggested next step.

kai (Eng): implementing an API flag probe_mode so frontend shows the proper CTA and a probe_summary array with items like "SSH: failed (timeout)". logs will avoid storing secrets; local script posts to a signed URL and auto‑expires.

tess (Design): proposed microcopy (compact):

"Run connectivity checks (recommended)"
"Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health‑checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials or commands are sent. If you cannot allow our IPs, download a local probe to run inside your network."

inline error example:
"SSH check failed — could not connect to bastion.internal:22. Verify outbound rules for Redwood health‑checker IPs or run the local probe."

marie (Product): avoid the term "allowlist" in UX; use "permitted IPs" or "allowed IPs". also add a short privacy link under the toggle: "Privacy details" that opens a brief blurb.

ben (UX): keyboard behavior: pressing Enter on the toggle should start the run; focus moves to a status region (role=status). error links must be keyboard accessible. SR reads interim and final results.

kai (Eng): i'll post the CIDRs and a short privacy blurb here by EOD. local probe will redact local paths/configs before uploading.

ci-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2025-11-15T05:00Z — FYI. :gear:

marie (Product): great, i'll update the spec to include default toggle state per deployment, the two CTAs, and the local probe fallback. tess, ben — ping when mocks are ready.

tess (Design): thanks — i'll push a compact mock and leave space for the privacy link.
